ios.desc:
AnywhereRoles is a remote job search app that goes past discovery: closed listings are hidden, suspicious ones get a scam warning, and every application you track stays in one place. Browse roles from multiple remote job sources, swipe through the best matches, and open the original listing when you are ready to apply.

REMOTE JOBS WITHOUT THE TAB CHAOS
* Browse remote jobs from multiple sources in one app
* Search by title, skill, company, or keyword
* Filter by category, company, tags, and source
* Swipe through fresh jobs: save the ones you like, pass on the rest
* Open the original listing when you are ready to apply

REMOTE JOBS YOU CAN TRUST
* Dead-link detection: jobs whose listing has closed are hidden, and open ones are marked verified open
* Scam warnings on listings that show classic red flags
* Hide a job, a company, or any keyword or source you never want to see again
* Labels show if a role is fully remote, limited to certain countries or hybrid, and whether it sponsors visas

FIT YOUR TIME ZONE
* Every job card shows how many working hours you would share with the team
* See whether a role is open to your country before you read the post
* A Remote Fit Score on each role, and company pages with remote policy and hiring pace
* Compare up to three companies side by side

STAY AHEAD OF NEW ROLES
* Job alerts for new matching jobs, with quiet hours so nothing buzzes at night
* Alerts show how many new jobs matched since you last looked
* Follow companies and hear when they post new remote roles
* Today feed and a notification inbox for everything that matters
* A widget with your freshest remote matches and weekly application progress

TRACK EVERY APPLICATION
* Save roles with notes, tags, and folders
* Move each role from saved to applied, interviewing, offered, or rejected on a list or a kanban board, with an interview log and offer comparison
* Keep the recruiter, hiring manager or referral for each application
* Add a job from any website with its link and track it with the rest
* Set a weekly application goal and keep your streak
* Save searches and re-run them quickly
* Turn your résumé into profile suggestions in one step

KNOW WHAT IT PAYS
* See the salary on any role that lists one, converted to USD
* Personalize swipe actions and what each job row shows, saved only on your device

ANYWHEREROLES PRO (OPTIONAL)
Everything above is free. Pro is an optional subscription that adds:
* Unlimited saved searches, instead of three
* Unlimited ac
